competitorChecks.label: Pro Game Guides - Best weapons in 99 Nights in the Forest

exclusions: Old Axe, Good Axe, Ice Axe, Strong Axe, Chainsaw, and Admin Axe are excluded because their primary role is utility/tool progression even though Fandom also tags Axes as weapons.

Fishing rods, flutes, sacks, flashlights, traps, crafting stations, armor bodies, helmets, cloaks, and ammunition are excluded because they belong to tools, armor, crafting, materials, or utility catalogs.
Brute Shield is excluded because a source-backed standalone row with exact combat use, source, and page data was not found during this pass.
notes: No item count should be used in public title copy until the parent confirms this dataset scope and shared renderer count.
Damage, ammo/use, effect, source, class restriction, and availability values are copied only where source-backed. Rows with unclear exact values use Not listed instead of guesses.
Unavailable and admin-only rows are sectioned separately for stale-guide clarity and should not appear in normal-run recommendation copy.

items.name: Spear
items.damage: 25; 32.5 with Brawler; 40 with fully boosted Berserker
items.effect: Longer melee reach than basic tools
items.source: Common Chest, Good Chest, Iron Chest, Pelt Trader second trade
items.bestFor: Early and mid-run melee damage when ammo should be saved.
items.sourceNote: The source page compares it against Axes and Revolver as an early to middle weapon.

items.name: Morningstar
items.damage: 70; 91 with Brawler; 112 with fully boosted Berserker
items.source: Gold Chest
items.bestFor: Heavy melee hits when the player can handle the slower swing.
items.sourceNote: The source describes it as very high melee damage with a slower swing rate.

items.name: Katana
items.damage: 25; 32.5 with Brawler; 40 with fully boosted Berserker
items.source: Assassin Class
items.bestFor: Assassin melee runs that want Spear-style damage with a faster swing.
items.sourceNote: The source says there is no other way to obtain the Katana outside Assassin.

items.name: Laser Sword
items.damage: 25; 30 at full charge; 2 during Alien Tech overheat; 32.5 with Brawler; 39 with Berserker full charge
items.effect: Full-charge AoE hit; weak damage while overheated
items.rateOrReload: 0.5 second swing rate; Alien Tech recharge
items.source: Alien Chest, Broken UFOs, Mothership UFOs
items.bestFor: Alien-tech melee and small crowd hits when the charge bar is managed.
items.sourceNote: Shares Alien Tech Energy with Raygun and Laser Cannon.

items.name: Ice Sword
items.damage: 35; 45.5 with Brawler; 56 with fully boosted Berserker
items.source: Ice Chest
items.bestFor: Melee control against fast enemies and snow-biome fights.
items.sourceNote: Source says it is obtained only from the Snow Biome.

items.name: Trident
items.damage: 37.5; 48.75 with Brawler; 61.8 with fully boosted Berserker
items.source: Fishing; gold presents from the 2025 Christmas event
items.bestFor: Rare melee upgrade from fishing, especially with melee-damage classes.
items.sourceNote: The source says it is most likely from Skeleton or Bone Lakes and is rare from fishing.

items.name: Poison Claws
items.effect: Poison effect on hit; short range
items.source: Jungle Chest
items.location: Mother Temple bottom floor, Jungle Biome
items.bestFor: Fast close-range poison damage when the player can handle short range.
items.sourceNote: The source page is less polished than core weapon pages, but it lists damage, swing rate, source, and poison effect.

items.name: Poison Spear
items.damage: 25; 32.5 with Brawler; 40 with fully boosted Berserker
items.source: Frog Chest; Frog Pond dock; gold presents
items.bestFor: Spear-style kiting with poison chip damage.
items.sourceNote: The source says Jungle Cultists can also spawn with it.

items.name: Infernal Sword
items.effect: Burning effect; cooks meat drops when it gets the kill
items.source: Red-spiked chest, Cultist King drop, Volcano sacrifice reward
items.bestFor: Volcanic-biome melee, burn utility, and food safety from cooked drops.
items.sourceNote: The Volcanic Biome source notes Hellephants ignore the burning effect.

items.name: Obsidiron Hammer
items.damage: 70; 91 with Brawler; 112 with fully boosted Berserker; about 60 explosion damage when charged
items.effect: Hit meter triggers an explosion when full
items.source: Obsidiron Chest; event/reward routes noted by source
items.bestFor: Heavy melee hits with occasional area burst once the meter fills.
items.sourceNote: The page is marked as a stub and has a typo in the item name, but lists damage, swing rate, source, and explosion effect.

items.name: Scythe
items.effect: Life-steal style health regeneration after enough hits
items.source: Vampire Chest; Thanksgiving Table
items.bestFor: Sustained melee combat where health regeneration can keep the run alive.
items.sourceNote: The source says the Scythe needs about 10 hits to regenerate health.

items.name: Vampire Scythe
items.effect: Blood meter shared with Vampire Cloak; heals when filled
items.source: Vampire Class
items.bestFor: Vampire class melee sustain and Cultist Stronghold-style fights.
items.sourceNote: The source says it cannot be dropped by the player.

items.name: Revolver
items.source: Armory, Good Chest, Iron Chest, Pelt Trader second trade, Ranger Class
items.bestFor: Early ranged damage and pulling enemies before stronger headshot weapons.
items.sourceNote: The source warns against wasting it on high-health enemies when stronger weapons are needed.

items.name: Rifle
items.source: Gunsmith Shed, Iron Chest, Legendary Chest, Pelt Trader third trade
items.bestFor: Headshot damage on wolves, alpha wolves, bears, and other dangerous targets.
items.sourceNote: The source says switching weapons does not cancel the Rifle reload.

items.name: Tactical Shotgun
items.damage: 8 pellets per shot; 10 per pellet; 20 per pellet on headshot; 80 or 160 potential per shot; 256 with max Berserker
items.ammoOrUses: Shotgun Ammo; 3-shot magazine; starts with 43 shells when first picked up
items.source: Ruby Chest; chance as a Workshop crafting recipe
items.craftingRequirement: Crafting recipe can appear at the Workshop; exact recipe not listed on source page
items.bestFor: Close-range burst against groups and high-pressure fights.
items.sourceNote: The page states each shot consumes one Shotgun Ammo even though it fires multiple pellets.

items.name: Air Rifle
items.source: Third Carnival Game / Shooting Gallery minigame
items.bestFor: Carnival shooting game, enemy aggro, or health testing rather than real damage.
items.sourceNote: The source calls it the lowest-damage weapon and says it is mainly for the Carnival game.

items.name: Raygun
items.ammoOrUses: Alien Tech Energy; about 13 shots before overheat at maximum fire rate
items.effect: Hitscan alien weapon; overheats at zero Alien Tech Energy
items.rateOrReload: Alien Tech Energy recharge; full overheat recharge about 9.5 seconds
items.source: Broken UFOs, Mothership UFOs, Alien Chest, Alien Class
items.bestFor: Safe repeated ranged damage when ammo conservation matters.
items.sourceNote: Shares Alien Tech Energy with Laser Sword and Laser Cannon.

items.name: Laser Cannon
items.ammoOrUses: Alien Tech Energy; infinite ammo but heavy charge use
items.effect: AoE ranged blast; does not get headshot damage
items.source: Broken UFOs, Mothership UFOs, Alien Chest, Cyborg Class, some event reward routes
items.bestFor: Crowd control and burst damage when the long recharge is worth it.
items.sourceNote: The source notes it uses around 60%-80% of the Alien Tech Energy bar.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.ammoOrUses: Fuel Canisters and Oil Barrels; 150 capacity
items.effect: Burning effect; cooks meat drops when it gets the kill
items.rateOrReload: 0.05 second fire rate; no normal reload listed
items.source: Pyromaniac Class
items.bestFor: Short-range crowd control, rescues, and cooked food from animal kills.
items.sourceNote: The source says it is the only weapon that uses fuel as ammunition.

items.name: Blowpipe
items.rateOrReload: Slow reload; exact time not listed
items.source: Frog Chest, fishing at Frog Pond, Poison Master Class, Vine Chest
items.classRestriction: Poison Master Class can provide it
items.bestFor: Poison ranged pressure when exact damage is less important than effect and uptime.
items.sourceNote: The source is the Items table; the Blowpipe page redirects to the Items ranged section.

items.name: Crossbow
items.source: Hot Chest
items.bestFor: Volcanic-biome ranged poke between stronger weapon reloads.
items.sourceNote: The source says Cultists can also be seen with Crossbows.

items.name: Infernal Crossbow
items.effect: Burning effect; cooks meat drops when it gets the kill
items.rateOrReload: Slightly faster reload than Crossbow; exact time not listed
items.source: Red-spiked chest, Cultist King drop, Volcano sacrifice reward, Fire Bandit Class
items.classRestriction: Fire Bandit Class can provide it
items.bestFor: Burning ranged damage with infinite ammo in volcanic routes.
items.sourceNote: The Volcanic Biome source says every 24th sacrifice gives a 50/50 chance between Infernal Sword and Infernal Crossbow.

items.name: Snowball
items.damage: Low damage; exact value not listed
items.ammoOrUses: 40-infinite listed by source; some Christmas shovel snowballs had 5 uses
items.source: Snow Chest; Gambler Class rare occasions
items.location: Snow Biome, medium snow cabins, large snow cabins, North Pole biome during Christmas event
items.bestFor: Slowing enemies while escaping or setting up stronger damage.
items.sourceNote: The source warns that the freezing effect does not affect Polar Bears.

items.name: Frozen Shuriken
items.damage: Lower than Kunai; exact value not listed
items.source: Ice Chest
items.bestFor: Slowing hordes and fast enemies before finishing with stronger damage.
items.sourceNote: The source calls it the Snow Biome counterpart to Kunai.

items.name: Kunai
items.ammoOrUses: 100 capacity; 120 with Assassin Class; disappears from inventory when out of ammo
items.rateOrReload: Fire rate around Raygun; no reload
items.source: Ruby Chest; Assassin Class; Assassin chest spawn chance
items.classRestriction: Assassin Class can provide it and improve capacity
items.bestFor: Fast ranged damage in raids or dangerous rooms before the stack runs out.
items.sourceNote: Also known as Throwing Knives in Assassin Class preview.

items.name: Wildfire
items.damage: Tick damage from fire puddles; exact value not listed
items.ammoOrUses: One-time-use throwable; stacks in one slot
items.source: Hot Chest, Cultist King, Fire Bandit Class
items.classRestriction: Fire Bandit Class can provide it
items.bestFor: Area denial and crowd damage against clustered enemies or tanky threats.
items.sourceNote: The source says thrown Wildfires create 2-3 fire puddles in a medium radius.

items.name: Witch Potion
items.ammoOrUses: Infinite uses; 6 second cooldown per throw
items.effect: Damage, knockback, burning, poison, and teammate healing at Witch level 2
items.source: Witch Class
items.bestFor: Class-only support damage, poison/burn effects, and teammate healing.
items.sourceNote: The source lists damage as TBA, so no exact damage value is used.

items.name: Bouncing Blade
items.ammoOrUses: Limited; exact stack/use count not listed
items.effect: Bounces from first target to nearby target; builds life-steal energy
items.source: Vampire Chest
items.bestFor: Chain-hit utility when enemies are grouped and life-steal energy matters.
items.sourceNote: The standalone page is short; the Items table confirms the Vampire Chest source and two-target bounce behavior.

items.name: Cultist Staff
items.ammoOrUses: 3 souls to summon a normal dead cultist; 10 souls for Cultist King
items.effect: Summons cultists from defeated cultists using souls
items.source: Necromancer Class
items.bestFor: Necromancer summon play, not direct weapon damage.
items.sourceNote: Included because the source categorizes it as a weapon and it directly affects combat through summons.

items.name: Riot Shield
items.effect: Reduces damage when held; blocks arrows
items.source: Ruby Chest, Tool Workshop
items.craftingRequirement: Tool Workshop source listed; exact recipe not listed on source page
items.bestFor: Blocking unavoidable damage or arrows before switching back to a weapon.
items.sourceNote: Included as defensive combat gear; source says the player cannot attack while holding it.
items.imageStatus: local direct combat gear image present

items.name: Admin Gun
items.source: Admin / Update Party only
items.bestFor: Historical reference only; not a normal run goal.
items.sourceNote: Kept out of normal-run sections because the source says it cannot be normally obtained.

items.name: Friendly Gun
items.effect: Unavailable gun with Raygun model; source says it can kill teammates
items.rateOrReload: Very fast fire rate and no recharge time per Items table; exact values not listed
items.source: Update Party only
items.bestFor: Historical reference only; not a normal run goal.
items.sourceNote: No standalone Fandom page was found; included only because the Items table names it as an unavailable weapon.

items.name: Cultist King Mace
items.source: Admin-only
items.bestFor: Stale-guide clarity around false drop rumors.
items.sourceNote: The Volcanic Biome source says rumors of a Cultist King Mace drop are false and that it can only be spawned by admins.
